NewsArticle.Title: The Sacrifice: Summoner's Dream
NewsArticle.Content: Hesperos, bard of Undine had a horrible nightmare concerning the goblins and Summoner's Dream on 99.10.01 - 99.10.03. He wrote about it in verse: Summoner's Dream Piercing the night, shouts and screams, followed by sounds obscene. Never sleep, for fear of the summoner's dream. Late at night, under a moon of red. I struck out, clutch'd by hatred and sweaty fear, from bed. Children, women, and young boys taken and tied to stakes, rocks, and left there. Till black talos dust was wafted over their eyes, and till blood's curdle silenced their cries. Dark nights, throw all into a shudder, when we hear the Dark Knight's wing'd flutter. Gasp and cry and wish for day's innocence. No sanctuary, no grace, from these summoners' malevolence. Undying Undine. Where are your children? Hesperos Bard of Undine Enter Dark Ages, listen to the Events of Temuair and talk to Hesperos in Undine Tavern for details. Read "Wood Goblin Social Structure" in Loures Library Philosophy wing: [www.darkages.com/atavism/phi](http://www.darkages.com/atavism/phi)
